keyVerseDR: "And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so must the Son of man be lifted up:" (Jn 3:14)

level1.title: The Cross of Love
level1.story: Jesus said, "God loved the world so much that He gave His only Son." Jesus died on the cross to save us. We honor the Cross because Jesus loves us!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How do we make the Sign of the Cross?
actions: Make the Sign of the Cross carefully
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for the cross. Amen.

activity.title: The Holy Cross
activity.intro: Fill the cross with fingerprints of love.
activity.label: We adore You, O Christ

level2.title: Lifted Up
level2.story: Jesus told Nicodemus, "No man hath ascended into heaven, but He that descended from heaven, the Son of man." He said, "As Moses lifted up the serpent in the desert, so must the Son of man be lifted up." Whoever believes in Him may have life everlasting. "For God so loved the world, as to give His only begotten Son." God sent His Son not to judge the world, but that the world may be saved by Him.
level2.keyLine: So must the Son of man be lifted up.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: How is the bronze serpent like the cross?
Why do Catholics display the crucifix?
actions: Pray the Stations of the Cross
level2.prayer: We adore You, O Christ, and we bless You. Amen.
